anomalies.name: EmbeddedProgram
anomalies.desc: File embeds a program

anomalies.name: HighXrefLoopingFunction

anomalies.name: ImportByHash
anomalies.desc: APIs are imported by hash

anomalies.name: InvalidChecksum
anomalies.desc: PE Header checksum is wrong

anomalies.name: ManyHighValueImmediates
anomalies.desc: Function contains at least 5 and more than 10% of high-value immediate operands (i.e. immediate values that contains at least 2 non-zero non-FF bytes and are not a valid address)

anomalies.name: ManyUniqueImmediateBytes
anomalies.desc: More than 48 unique bytes defined across all immediate operands in the function

anomalies.name: SectionMostlyVirtual
anomalies.desc: section is composed of mostly virtual space

anomalies.name: SequentialFunction
anomalies.desc: function with very little intra jumps and calls, usually a crypto function, unrolled loops or data initialisation

anomalies.name: SpaghettiFunction
anomalies.desc: Function with lots of intra jumps, could be obfuscated

anomalies.name: StackArrayInitialisationX86
anomalies.desc: An array of data is dynamically built on the stack, sometimes used to build shellcodes or strings

anomalies.name: UnbalancedVirtualPhysicalRatio
anomalies.desc: huge difference between the physical and virtual size of a section

anomalies.name: XorInLoop
anomalies.desc: XOR instruction in a loop
